description: Wooden hinged box with 2 wooden trays. The exterior of the lid is engraved with an image of a dragon or griffin holding a shield with a bundle of wheat along with the letters S and M, Paris and remnants of tape. The interior of the lid is engraved with a dragon figure or Griffin with the following text: Pastels Henri Roche, Maison du Pastel, Fondee en 1720, Fabrique & Magasin de Vente, 20 Rue de Rambuteau, Paris IIIe.  One tray contains numerous soft pastel sticks and pieces in multiple colors; shades of pink, purple, blue, green, red, yellow, orange, brown and black. The second tray is empty.  Most of the  pastel sticks have label wrappers: Maison du Pastel - Henri Roche, 20 Rue de Rambuleau, Paris.  The longest pastel is 2 1/2 x 1 1/4 inches and the smallest pastels are 1/4 x 1/4 inches. The pastels in this box were used extensively by the artist.
